- https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/health/connect/client/records/ExerciseSessionRecord
- https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/health/connect/client/records/ExerciseSegment
- https://developer.android.com/reference/android/health/connect/datatypes/ExerciseSessionType
- https://github.com/androidx/androidx/blob/androidx-main/health/connect/connect-client/src/main/java/androidx/health/connect/client/records/ExerciseSessionRecord.kt
- https://github.com/androidx/androidx/blob/androidx-main/health/connect/connect-client/src/main/java/androidx/health/connect/client/records/ExerciseSegment.kt
- https://github.com/androidx/androidx/blob/androidx-main/health/connect/connect-client/src/main/java/androidx/health/connect/client/impl/platform/records/IntDefMappings.kt
- https://developer.android.com/reference/androidx/health/services/client/data/ExerciseType
- https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/health/services/client/data/ExerciseType
- https://github.com/androidx/androidx/blob/androidx-main/health/health-services-client/src/main/java/androidx/health/services/client/data/ExerciseType.kt
- https://developer.android.com/health-and-fitness/health-services/active-data
- https://developer.android.com/health-and-fitness/health-connect/data-types
- https://developer.apple.com/documentation/healthkit/hkworkoutactivitytype
- https://developer.apple.com/documentation/healthkit/hkworkoutactivitytype
- https://developers.google.com/health/reference/rest

Every workout or exercise type constant on four platforms, read up to 2026-10-18: Apple's HKWorkoutActivityType cases (names, abstracts, groups and availability from Apple's documentation JSON, discussions from each case's own page), Health Connect's ExerciseSessionRecord.EXERCISE_TYPE_* constants (values from Google's Jetpack reference; the platform API's ExerciseSessionType constant, value and API level each converts to, from IntDefMappings.kt in the androidx source and Google's platform reference; the segment types each accepts, from the table behind ExerciseSegment.isSegmentTypeCompatibleWithSessionType in ExerciseSegment.kt), Wear OS Health Services' ExerciseType constants (names and descriptions from Google's reference, ids from the androidx ExerciseType.kt it links) and the Google Health API's exerciseType enum (the v4 discovery document). Names, values and descriptions are copied exactly. HealthKit values are null because Apple prints none; Google Health API values are null because the enum value is the string itself. One column is DERIVED: crosswalkKey. Two constants share a crosswalk row only when their names are identical after removing a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ (Health Connect's prefix, which the Google Health API also uses on EXERCISE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED), lowercasing, and removing every character that is not a letter or a digit. sameNameOn lists the constants of the other platforms with the same key. No Apple or Google page read for this dataset maps one list onto another, so nothing is joined by meaning.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `platform` | healthkit, health-connect, wear-os or google-health-api | string | 0 of 412 rows |
| `enumeration` | The platform's enumeration | string | 0 of 412 rows |
| `constant` | The constant exactly as the source spells it | string | 0 of 412 rows |
| `qualified` | How code writes it | string | 0 of 412 rows |
| `value` | Health Connect: the Jetpack value. Wear OS: the id ExerciseType.kt passes. Null for HealthKit (Apple prints none) and the Google Health API (string enum) | integer, null | 266 of 412 rows |
| `description` | HealthKit: Apple's abstract. Others: the source's description; null where it gives none | null, string | 143 of 412 rows |
| `discussion` | HealthKit: Apple's discussion paragraphs, verbatim; null where Apple gives none | null, string | 379 of 412 rows |
| `group` | HealthKit: Apple's topic group | null, string | 328 of 412 rows |
| `iosIntroduced` | HealthKit: the iOS version Apple lists | null, string | 328 of 412 rows |
| `deprecated` | yes when the source marks the constant deprecated; null where the source has no such field | null, string | 182 of 412 rows |
| `platformApiConstant` | Health Connect: the platform ExerciseSessionType constant the Jetpack library converts to | null, string | 351 of 412 rows |
| `platformApiValue` | Health Connect: that constant's value on the platform reference | integer, null | 351 of 412 rows |
| `platformApiLevel` | Health Connect: the API level the platform reference gives it | integer, null | 351 of 412 rows |
| `platformApiDeprecatedIn` | Health Connect: the API level the platform reference deprecates it in | integer, null | 411 of 412 rows |
| `segmentRule` | Health Connect: any, listed or universal-only (see the hub's segment section) | null, string | 351 of 412 rows |
| `segments` | Health Connect: the segment types the library's table names for the session type, beyond the universal ones | null, string | 392 of 412 rows |
| `crosswalkKey` | DERIVED: the name with a leading EXERCISE_TYPE_ removed, lowercased, characters outside a-z0-9 removed | string | 0 of 412 rows |
| `sameNameOn` | Constants of other platforms with the same crosswalkKey; null when none | null, string | 159 of 412 rows |
| `source` | The source page the constant was read from | string | 0 of 412 rows |
| `page` | This site's row for the constant | string | 0 of 412 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/workoutTypes.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-workout-types.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-10-18.
- No workflow runs that script: it is run by hand when the sources are re-read.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
